admission.justification: An incorrect root or cleanup binding could alter a developer home, leak credentials into evidence, or let one trial contaminate another.

applicability: Native eval case fixtures, private actor homes, effect capture and ownership-checked cleanup.
conditions: Each attempt gets a fresh declared-input fixture, a private actor state and bound code/memory repositories.
Effects are captured only through verified declared aliases/roots and credential-named evidence is refused before reading.
Uncertain actor creation keeps the fixture until supported host stop; cleanup remains inside its declared private home.
exclusions: User-level harness configuration and real host-state writes.
Foreign homes or fixtures becoming cleanup targets.
A proof that citation_write_preflight runs in every trial; it has a separate disposable test caller.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: Each native trial uses a fresh fixture and private actor state, with cleanup and effect capture confined to declared repositories and homes.
